title: 市

sentences.imageNotes: 主角媽媽帶主角小女孩去市場買菜，畫面有菜攤和新鮮蔬菜，主角媽媽正在挑菜或付錢前看菜。市場攤販是清楚的店家角色，不能長得像主角媽媽或老師。不可有價目表、文字、數字、招牌、品牌或標籤。
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L238-S01 lesson image for a Taiwan preschool Traditional Chinese character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist mother takes the protagonist little girl to a traditional market to buy vegetables. A vegetable stall with fresh leafy greens and vegetables is centered. The protagonist mother is looking carefully at vegetables before paying; a visually distinct market vendor stands behind the stall as a clear shopkeeper role.
Visual cast: use protagonist little girl and protagonist mother identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 family continuity. The mother is a warm family adult in practical home/outdoor clothing, visually distinct from teachers and vendors. The market vendor is a different adult shopkeeper with different hairstyle, clothing color, face shape, and posture; do not make the vendor look like the protagonist mother or teacher. Use the approved L058 lesson images only as style references: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed but clean environments, expressive preschool proportions, bright warm palette, and phone-readable square composition. Do not copy any specific person from L058.
Composition: center the mother, little girl, vendor, vegetable stall, and fresh vegetables with safe margins for square app preview. Keep all meaning-bearing objects large and phone-readable.
Constraints: no price list, no text, no numbers, no signs, no labels, no zhuyin, no logos, no brands, no watermarks, no readable marks.
